faces.name: Legion Loyalty
faces.oracleText: Creatures you control have myriad. (Whenever a creature with myriad attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.)

faces.name: Legion of Clay
faces.oracleText:
Creatures you control have trample.
Whenever one or more nontoken artifacts enter under your control, creatures you control perpetually get +1/+1.

faces.name: Legion Reconsecrator
faces.oracleText:
Whenever Legion Reconsecrator attacks, exile up to one target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, conjure a duplicate of it into your graveyard. The duplicate perpetually becomes a black Skeleton with base power and toughness 3/1 in addition to its other colors and types.
When Legion Reconsecrator dies, return another target creature card with power or toughness 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.

faces.name: Legion's Chant
faces.oracleText:
Starting intensity 3
Return any number of creature cards with total mana value X or less from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is Legion's Chant's intensity.
All Chorus cards you own intensify by 1.

faces.name: Legion's End
faces.oracleText: Exile target creature an opponent controls with mana value 2 or less and all other creatures that player controls with the same name as that creature. Then that player reveals their hand and exiles all cards with that name from their hand and graveyard.

faces.name: Legion's Initiative
faces.oracleText:
Red creatures you control get +1/+0.
White creatures you control get +0/+1.
{R}{W}, Exile this enchantment: Exile all creatures you control. At the beginning of the next combat, return those cards to the battlefield under their owner's control and those creatures gain haste until end of turn.

faces.name: Legion's Judgment
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature with power 4 or greater.

cards.name: Legion's Landing // Adanto, the First Fort

faces.name: Legion's Landing
faces.oracleText:
When Legion's Landing enters, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
When you attack with three or more creatures, transform Legion's Landing.

faces.name: Adanto, the First Fort
faces.oracleText:
(Transforms from Legion's Landing.)
{T}: Add {W}.
{2}{W}, {T}: Create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
